import os
import subprocess
import sys

from sase.vcs_provider import get_vcs_provider

checkout_target = {{ setup.checkout_target | tojson }}
project_name = {{ setup.project_name | tojson }}
gh_ref = {{ gh_ref | tojson }}

provider = get_vcs_provider(os.getcwd())

# Checkout the PR branch so that subsequent diffs are relative to the
# PR tip rather than the default branch. Try checkout_target first
# (works for default-branch refs like origin/main), then fall back to
# Patch name -> branch name conversion.
is_patch = checkout_target == f"origin/{gh_ref}"
ok, err = provider.checkout(checkout_target, os.getcwd())
if not ok:
    if is_patch:
        # Patch ref — resolve name to branch name
        resolved = provider.resolve_revision(
            gh_ref, project_name, os.getcwd()
        )
        ok, err = provider.checkout(resolved, os.getcwd())
    else:
        # Project/repo ref — try common default branch names
        for fallback in ["master", "main"]:
            ok, err = provider.checkout(fallback, os.getcwd())
            if ok:
                break
    if not ok:
        print(
            f"Warning: checkout failed: {err}",
            file=sys.stderr,
        )

# Sync with remote after checkout
subprocess.run(
    ["git", "pull", "--rebase", "--quiet"],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
    check=False,
)

# Record HEAD for the diff step
result = subprocess.run(
    ["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
    check=False,
)
head = result.stdout.strip() if result.returncode == 0 else ""
print(f"head_before={head}")
print("success=true")

head_before="{{ checkout.head_before }}"
if [ -z "$head_before" ]; then
  exit 0
fi
head_now=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
diff_dir="${SASE_TMPDIR:-${SASE_HOME:-$HOME/.sase}/tmp}/gh-diffs"
mkdir -p "$diff_dir"
diff_file=$(mktemp "$diff_dir/sase-gh-XXXXXX.diff")
if [ "$head_now" != "$head_before" ]; then
  # Commits were made — show only the last commit's diff
  git diff HEAD~1 HEAD > "$diff_file" 2>/dev/null
  commit_msg=$(git log -1 --format='%s' HEAD)
  echo "meta_commit_message=$commit_msg"
else
  # No commits — show uncommitted changes
  git diff HEAD > "$diff_file" 2>/dev/null
  git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -z 2>/dev/null \
    | while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do
        git diff --no-index /dev/null "$f" 2>/dev/null
      done >> "$diff_file"
fi
if [ -s "$diff_file" ]; then
  echo "diff_path=$diff_file"
else
  rm -f "$diff_file"
fi

# Stash any uncommitted changes (including untracked files)
if ! git diff --quiet HEAD 2>/dev/null || [ -n "$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard)" ]; then
  git stash push --include-untracked -m "gh-workflow-$(date +%s)" --quiet
  echo "stashed=true"
else
  echo "stashed=false"
fi
git fetch origin --quiet 2>&1 || true
git pull --rebase --quiet 2>/dev/null || true
echo "success=true"

from sase_github.scripts.gh_setup import main
main(
    gh_ref={{ gh_ref | tojson }},
    n={{ n | tojson }},
    release={{ release | tojson }},
    workflow_label={{ workflow_label | tojson }},
)

I closed epic bob-cli-gr: all 17 weekly Reviews (2026-W43 back to W27) are drafted and in the vault. I deleted two stray plan files two phases had left in the vault, which the epic said must not happen.

**What I checked**
- `bob periods brief` reports `closed · drafted` for every week from W27 to W43. W44, W45, W46 and the Q3/Q4 notes were not touched.
- Each week was committed once, by vault auto-sync, and only to its own note. Each commit only adds lines: two bob-written frontmatter keys and the `## Review` block.
- A script over all 17 Reviews found every one has a Headline, no Intentions part, at most 250 words, and only links that resolve to an existing note and block.
- The epic made no bob-cli code changes, as planned.

**Stray files removed**
The W43 and W42 phases committed with `/sase_git_commit`, which also put their plan files into `~/bob/sdd/plans/`. They were outdated copies of plans that already live in the bob-cli plans repo. I deleted them, and vault sync committed and pushed that as `6fb387ad5`. Since the epic began, the vault has changed only in the 17 week notes, plus two edits of yours from the MacBook and apollo.

**Changes that landed during the epic**
The bob-cli commits since the epic began (capture, task-merge, task-split, attachments) don't touch the brief code. Task-merge only rewrites Depends-On lines, so it can't alter the new Reviews. Nothing needed updating.

**Follow-up tasks (all marked ready)**
None of these were caused by this epic: six are bugs in `bob periods brief` from the earlier period-notes epic (bob-cli-gh), and the last is the vault plan-file problem going forward.

| Task | Size | Problem | From |
|---|---|---|---|
| bob-cli-gs | medium | Tasks archived to `done/` lose their minutes and get links that don't resolve | gr.1, gr.5, gr.17 |
| bob-cli-gt | medium | Each linked task is credited the whole Pomodoro, so tasks outrank their own root | gr.3, gr.16, gr.17 |
